Hannah Park: Heads-up — Polaris onboarding cost spike overnight after they ramped document embeddings. Need a short mitigation for the QBR and a one-paragraph customer note. cc @Leo
Leo Martin: Looking. 24h burn = $7.2k, projected 30d = $216k if unchanged. Their usual run rate ~ $48k/mo. Credits left = $15k, retainer = $15k/mo, retainer expires in 18 days.
Omar Ibrahim: Do we know driver? indexer vs live queries?
Leo Martin: Indexing (bulk reindex) = 62% of spike, live queries = 28%, misc = 10%. They launched parallel reindexing to speed up migration.
Hannah Park: For QBR slide: (1) short incident timeline, (2) immediate actions we took, (3) recommended CTAs (enablement + commit ask). Keep it customer-friendly.
Omar Ibrahim: Quick mitigations to propose: 1) pause or throttle indexer 2) swap indexer model -> quantized variant 3) enable batching for live queries.
Leo Martin: Draft policy snippet for slide: ```yaml
policy: account_budget_guard
soft: 25000
hard: 35000
soft_action: notify-cs + warn-customer
hard_action: pause-indexer + swap-to-compact-model
```
ops-bot: Account POLARIS: credits_remaining=15000, retainer_monthly=15000, retainer_expiry=2026-04-05, auto_renew=false.
billing-bot: ALERT: POLARIS crossed 60% credits at 1746659800. Owner notified.
Hannah Park: Action items: Leo — paste 3 scenario forecasts (status quo, quantized+batch, pause-index) by EOD. Omar — prep CLI toggles + rollback steps. I'll draft customer note and the QBR slide.
Omar Ibrahim: CLI snippets ready for ops: ```bash
# pause indexer
rwctl jobs pause --account POLARIS --job indexer
# reduce concurrency
rwctl jobs update --account POLARIS --job indexer --concurrency 2
# swap model
rwctl accounts set-model --account POLARIS --route embeddings --model open-embed-q4-8bit --batch-size 64
# revert
rwctl jobs resume --account POLARIS --job indexer
```
Leo Martin: Scenarios: status_quo = $216k, quantized+batches = $120k, pause_index = $66k. Note: pausing impacts ingestion SLA.
Hannah Park: Good — also include an enablement offer: 30m workshop + 10-day monitoring window. Frame as "predictability package."
Leo Martin: Will add a tiny sparkline for runway to the slide.
Hannah Park: Meeting 3:30pm to finalize. :thumbsup:
